verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships a built-in 'AI Agents' feature (Agent Builder) letting users create custom assistants with code interpretation, file handling, API actions, web search, and can be invoked via '@' mention or subagents/skills for delegated tasks — a clear built-in assistant delegation model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating agent task delegation in practice (community evidence covers only general plugin/model usage, not agent delegation specifically).
